Question: With the reference of Q No145 & Fatwa No.137 In Quran, Ana Basharom Mislo Kom, more over for Nabi SAW life, he is in Maqam E Mahmood or in Madina Grave, if in Madina Grave then why Sahab put a Great and repected and ALIVE nabi in a QABAR?pls. explain in the light of Quran and Hadith only no tales or stories? Answer ID: 5301 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 693/693=M/1429 The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) is alive in his grave in Madinah. The companions (Sahaba, may Allah be pleased with them) buried the Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) because he had passed away, as the Holy Quran said: إنك ميت وإنهم ميتون (الأيه) And occurring death is not against Prophet-hood. There were many prophets before the Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) who tasted death. The life of the Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) in grave is Barzakhi (transitional). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
